info.title: AICTE Application Validation Prototype
info.description: Synthetic decision-support demo for SIH 2026 PS 26261. Not an AICTE-integrated service.

get.summary: Health
List Applications
Validate

post.summary: Upload, persist, and register an application document (S1 Ingest, Guide §4)
post.description: Streams multipart upload, computes BLAKE3 and SHA-256 in one pass, enforces size limits, sniffs magic bytes (PDF, PNG, JPEG), rejects encrypted PDFs, stores in content-addressed vault with deduplication, records blob and upload metadata in a database transaction, and supports idempotent replays via Idempotency-Key header.

get.summary: Retrieve routing and classification result for a persisted document

post.summary: Route and classify a persisted document (S3 Route, Guide §6)
post.description: Inspects extractable text, image coverage, and vector drawings using deterministic thresholds. Routes to Branch A (digital), Branch B (scanned raster), or Mixed. Does not perform forensics (S2), OCR, or document typing.

get.summary: Retrieve raw-byte forensic analysis result for a persisted document

post.summary: Execute raw-byte forensic analysis on a persisted document (S2 Forensics, Guide §5)
post.description: Inspects PDF metadata, incremental updates, digital signatures, image EXIF/geo, and QR locators on immutable original bytes through vault storage. All flags are advisory preliminary indicators.

get.summary: Retrieve S4 Branch B extraction result for a document

post.summary: Execute S4 Branch B extraction pipeline (Guide §7–§9)
post.description: Consumes S3 routes and persisted originals through storage abstraction. Runs raster preprocessing, single composed 3x3 coordinate transform, offline extraction engines, table cell normalisation, arithmetic verification, and produces C1 Unified Document Payload. Processing is cache-aware and idempotent.

get.summary: Retrieve document typing result for an application document

post.summary: Classify document type and checklist selection (S5 Typing, Guide §11.1)
post.description: Evaluates page 1 text and layout blocks against deterministic rules per document type. Incorporates bounded slot prior, grounds evidence to blocks and normalized bounding boxes, and flags DOC_TYPE_SLOT_MISMATCH if detected type differs from declared slot. Result is cached idempotently.

get.summary: Retrieve extracted fields and completeness status for an application document

post.summary: Extract schema-driven fields and ground bounding boxes (S6/S6b, Guide §11.2, §11.3)
post.description: Loads field schema for classified document type, extracts values via regex/layout, enforces 4-digit date policy, grounds each value to block/word coordinates, checks completeness (COMPLETE vs INCOMPLETE), and records C3 typed facts in database.

get.summary: Retrieve aggregated typed facts and entity resolution for an application (S7, Guide §11.4)
get.description: Aggregates C3 typed facts across application form data, authorised synthetic records (institute, approved programmes, TER payment, deficiencies), and persisted document extractions. Resolves canonical institution and compares document name aliases using Guide §11.4 core/legal form policy.

get.summary: Retrieve S8 Rules Engine evaluation result for an application

post.summary: Execute S8 Rules Engine evaluation on an application (Guide §12)
post.description: Loads active rule set, evaluates deterministic compliance and comparison rules against aggregated typed facts (C3) through the Three-Valued Gate, creates actionable findings (C5), and returns the validation report.

get.summary: Retrieve document verification result

post.summary: Execute document verification gateway query (S9, Guide §13)
post.description: Queries authoritative verification adapter (e.g. simulated QR registry, cryptographic digital signature, mock portal), computes field-by-field comparisons, records attempt, and yields C6 verification result with honest simulation labels.

get.summary: Evaluate infrastructure evidence checklist and location norms (S10, Guide §14)
get.description: Evaluates facility photo evidence inventory, geotagged metadata against registered campus coordinates, perceptual hash cross-institution deduplication, and form claims vs minimum area norms.

get.summary: Get unified application aggregation, status, review lanes, priority, and alerts (S11, Guide 11.7)
get.description: Combines forensic signals (S2), deterministic rules and findings (S8), issuing authority verifications (S9), and infrastructure evidence (S10). Derives workflow status, assignable review lane, queue priority score, and actionable alerts.

post.summary: Record officer action on finding (S12 Review, Guide §17)
post.description: Records human officer action on an automated discrepancy finding (acknowledge, request_rectification, dismiss, escalate, resolve). Requires mandatory human reason, stores override beside original finding, and creates an S13 audit event.

get.summary: Get all recorded officer actions for an application (S12, Guide §17)
get.description: Retrieves chronological timeline of officer finding overrides and actions.

get.summary: Generate draft deficiency notice for institution (S12, Guide §11.8)
get.description: Compiles formal draft deficiency notice with two-sided evidence for open rectifiable findings. Strictly excludes internal anomaly flags or duplicate identities.

get.summary: Generate physical ground inspection brief (S12, Guide §11.8)
get.description: Compiles facilities requiring physical ground verification, pending verifications, and advisory indicators under the advisory banner.

get.summary: Generate comprehensive application evaluation report (S12, Guide §11.8)
get.description: Complete evaluation report including full checklist transparency table, findings with action history, verifications, infra evaluations, and cryptographic audit chain head.

get.summary: Retrieve audit trail log events (S13, Guide §15.1)
get.description: Retrieves tamper-evident sequential audit event log entries.

get.summary: Verify cryptographic integrity of audit hash chain (S13, Guide §15.1)
get.description: Sequentially recomputes and verifies SHA-256 hash chain links from genesis to head. Fails visibly on any tampering.

post.summary: Create signed Ed25519 external checkpoint (S13, Guide §15.1)
post.description: Anchors current audit hash chain state with an asymmetric Ed25519 signature.

get.summary: List signed audit checkpoints (S13, Guide §15.1)
get.description: Retrieves historical signed checkpoints for external audit anchoring.
